name: Probative benchmarks, 2025–2026
description: Probative benchmarks, 2025–2026: our data on law-firm marketing. Figures are approximate and shown as ranges: bands, named tiers and rounded values, one table per file. The public tables cover how quickly inquiries become signed clients, phone calls and signed clients, AI answers and organic search clicks, search-ad click costs, what people type, calls from ads, Local Services Ads leads, inquiries by quarter and ad cost per signed client. Each row gives the measure, the band or tier, its unit and a rough size band. Read the band, not a point. The methods page defines every measure. Five injury-case tables were added in version 5.0.0 (each row states its version): Google Ads cost per click-traced lead and signed client, the non-brand click cost and the fourth-quarter dip, the Google Ads budget split, and Local Services Ads lead timing, charges and call lengths.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Probative benchmarks, 2025–2026 (Version 5.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24098530
keywords: AI search benchmarks for law firms

distribution.name: benchmarks.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: benchmarks.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

recordSet.name: benchmarks
recordSet.description: The records of Probative benchmarks, 2025–2026, one per CSV row.

field.name: id
field.description: Stable row id: the table id and the row number

field.name: table
field.description: Table id (see the methods page for the list)

field.name: value
field.description: The middle of the band (or the rounded value); read the display column or the note for the band

field.name: unit
field.description: Unit of the value; "(band)" or "(tier)" means the figure is a range, not a point

field.name: display
field.description: The figure as published: a band, a named tier or a rounded value

field.name: n_band
field.description: A rough size band for the row (30+ or 100+)

field.name: note
field.description: The band or tier again, and what the figure counts

field.name: sourceLabels
field.description: The methods page that defines the measure

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
